chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-‘Abbas ibn Ma‘ruf, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from ‘Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, who said:

He was asked about a man who was unaware that he had to perform tawaf of the House until he returned to his family. He said: If it was due to ignorance, he must repeat the hajj, and a badanah is also due upon him.

key_terms.الْجَهَالَةِ: ignorance as the cause of the omission
key_terms.بَدَنَةٌ: a sacrificial camel or large sacrificial animal due as expiation
key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: of the House, meaning the Ka'bah
key_terms.جَهِلَ: was unaware or ignorant of the ruling
key_terms.يَطُوفَ: to perform tawaf, the ritual circumambulation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone unknowingly leaves the tawaf of hajj and returns to his family?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who omitted tawaf al-hajj out of ignorance and only realized it after returning home. In such a case, he must repeat the hajj and offer a badanah, showing the grave legal consequence of leaving an essential rite of hajj even through ignorance.
